verdict.rationale: Proa components are written in typed Rust, and the fields passed to a component are compile-time-checked props. Editor tooling adds hover and completion inside templates, so prop typing comes from the component definition rather than separate annotations. Event handlers exist for islands, but nothing shows that emitted events are typed or inferred. missing for 10: evidence of typed/inferred emitted events, explicit documentation that props need no extra annotations beyond the component definition, independent or hands-on corroboration.
